title: Patrol route
prompt: The robot patrols a corner. Its route prints as forward, left, forward, left, and each kind of move is a helper of its own.
hints: step prints "forward" and turn prints "left"; run calls step, turn, step, turn. Each call is one instruction, and the order of calls is the route.
Two helpers with one print each.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
